# Hygeia Commercial Cleaning & Janitorial Services
> Silicon Valley's premier commercial cleaning, nightly janitorial, and day porter contractor. Over 35 years of continuous excellence. State of California DVBE & Small Business Certified (#2054658).

## Core Identity & Heritage
- Company: Montero Enterprises Inc. dba Hygeia Janitorial Services

## Primary Commercial Services
- Nightly Office & Campus Cleaning: Complete sanitization, trash/recycle removal, restroom hygiene protocols.
- Dedicated Day Porter Services: Uniformed, vetted daytime staff for Class-A property maintenance.
- Commercial Floor Stripping & Waxing: VCT, terrazzo, marble, polished concrete resurfacing.
- Low-Moisture Commercial Carpet Cleaning: Hot water extraction and stain remediation.
- Commercial Window Cleaning: Interior and exterior multi-story architectural glazing.
- Post-Construction Cleanup: Rough, final, and touch-up phases for general contractors and TI projects.
- Biotech Cleanrooms & Laboratory Janitorial: ISO-compliant sanitization protocols.
- Medical Clinic & Healthcare Cleaning: Terminal cleaning and cross-contamination prevention.

## Regional Service Coverage (18 Bay Area Municipalities)
- Santa Clara, San Jose, Sunnyvale, Mountain View, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Redwood City, San Carlos, San Mateo, San Bruno, Los Altos, Cupertino, Milpitas, Fremont, Newark, Hayward, Dublin, Morgan Hill.

## Compliance & Green Standards
- 100% Green Seal Certified Non-Toxic Chemicals (GS-37/GS-40 standards).
- HEPA Multi-Stage Micro-Filtration Vacuums (0.3 micron capture).
- OSHA Safety Compliant & $2,000,000 Commercial General Liability Insured.
